Don't be afraid to make major changes!  The history always has the old versions, so if you screw up horribly, the page can always be reverted.  Likewise, don't worry all that much about penning beautiful prose and carefully referencing every statement (now, we're not saying outright ignore citing your sources and write horribly); after all, there will be plenty of time for that later. Right now it is important to simply add content!
